public_health_question.v: What is the purpose of World TB Day 2011, and how far has the United States progressed toward TB elimination?

ev.q: World TB Day provides an opportunity for TB programs, nongovernmental organizations, and others to describe problems and solutions related to the TB pandemic
World TB Day is observed each year on March 24

equity.level_reason: The notice says TB incidence is disproportionally greater among foreign-born persons and racial/ethnic minorities. The statement is cited from an earlier report, with no group results or quantities of the article's own.
